key_terms.الضُّحَىٰ: The late morning hours, specifically when the sun has risen and reached its zenith

ai.seo_question: What does the oath of Ad-Duha signify in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as a divine reassurance to the Prophet Muhammad (SAWW) during the *fatrah* (period of pause in revelation), affirming that God has not abandoned him nor is He displeased. The oath by *Ad-Duha* (the morning brightness) symbolizes the clarity and warmth of divine guidance returning after a period of spiritual testing or concealment. This context highlights the continuity of prophethood and the eventual manifestation of truth, resonating with the Shia emphasis on the Imamate as the enduring light of guidance.
